descriptions.strtoul: newlib strtoul: parses an unsigned long by calling _strtoul_r with the global reentrancy structure.
descriptions.strtol: newlib strtol: parses a long by calling _strtol_r with the global reentrancy structure.
descriptions.atoi: Appears to be newlib atoi: returns strtol(s, NULL, 10); the first of two identical bodies, named in archive order.
descriptions.atol: Appears to be newlib atol: returns strtol(s, NULL, 10); the second of two identical bodies, named in archive order.
